sources.scope: AMIGO press release of 07.07.2000 (distributor): the German Dschungel cards are on sale from 11 July 2000. Dated four days ahead of the start; Austria and Switzerland not examined.

excerpts.content: La fecha final del lanzamiento del producto será el 5 de febrero

sources.scope: cartaspokemon.es relaying the distributor Asmodee: the final Spanish launch date is 5 February 2013. A distributor date announced two days ahead (Wayback snapshot 2013-02-03), not an observed sale; the 1 February 2013 values on pokemon.com and WikiDex are not used.
sources.ownerDecision: Owner decision relayed by Hermes in #612 on 2026-11-18

excerpts.content: Aunque la verdadera fecha de lanzamiento, según Asmodee, es el 8 de mayo
excerpts.hashScope: exact UTF-8 excerpt only, not full HTTP response

sources.scope: cartaspokemon.es on the day of the nominal 1 May date: the real launch per the distributor Asmodee is 8 May 2013. The 1 May values on pokemon.com and WikiDex are not used.
sources.ownerDecision: Same acceptance as the Fronteras Cruzadas decision of 2026-11-18, applied to the matching Asmodee statement

sources.scope: PokéZentrum (published 2026-10-29) lists the campaign windows: Canada 3 Nov to 7 Dec, Australia 5 Nov to 9 Dec, USA 10 Nov to 14 Dec 2026. Canada is the first English-language market, so 3 November is the first supported availability; later markets and the German start (3 Dec) are not transferred.
sources.ownerDecision: Owner decision of 2026-11-18 (chat, relayed): use the first available date, Canada
